legend: Ann and Borya have n piles with candies and n is even number. There are ai candies in pile with number i.

Ann likes numbers which are square of some integer and Borya doesn't like numbers which are square of any integer. During one move guys can select some pile with candies and add one candy to it (this candy is new and doesn't belong to any other pile) or remove one candy (if there is at least one candy in this pile).

Find out minimal number of moves that is required to make exactly n / 2 piles contain number of candies that is a square of some integer and exactly n / 2 piles contain number of candies that is not a square of any integer.
input: First line contains one even integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 200 000) — number of piles with candies.
Second line contains sequence of integers a1, a2, ..., an (0 ≤ ai ≤ 109) — amounts of candies in each pile.
output: Output minimal number of steps required to make exactly n / 2 piles contain number of candies that is a square of some integer and exactly n / 2 piles contain number of candies that is not a square of any integer. If condition is already satisfied output 0.
note: In first example you can satisfy condition in two moves. During each move you should add one candy to second pile. After it size of second pile becomes 16. After that Borya and Ann will have two piles with number of candies which is a square of integer (second and fourth pile) and two piles with number of candies which is not a square of any integer (first and third pile).
In second example you should add two candies to any three piles.

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，可以通过两次操作满足条件。每次操作都应向第二堆中添加一颗糖果。操作后，第二堆的数量变为 16。此时，Borya 和 Ann 将拥有两堆糖果数量为某个整数平方的糖果堆（第二堆和第四堆），以及两堆糖果数量不是任何整数平方的糖果堆（第一堆和第三堆）。
在第二个样例中，你应该向任意三堆中各加入两颗糖果。

legend.ai: Ann 和 Borya 有 n 堆糖果，且 n 是偶数。编号为 i 的堆中有 a_i 颗糖果。
Ann 喜欢是某个整数平方的数，而 Borya 不喜欢是任意整数平方的数。在一次操作中，他们可以选择一堆糖果并向其中添加一颗糖果（这颗糖果是新的，不属于其他任何糖果堆），或移除一颗糖果（如果这堆中至少有一颗糖果）。
求使恰好 n/2 堆糖果的数量是某个整数的平方，且恰好 n/2 堆糖果的数量不是任何整数的平方所需的最少操作次数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个偶数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 200 000）——糖果堆的数量。
第二行包含整数序列 a1, a2, ..., an（0 ≤ ai ≤ 10^9）——每堆糖果的数量。

output.ai: 输出使恰好 n/2 堆糖果的数量是某个整数的平方，且恰好 n/2 堆糖果的数量不是任何整数的平方所需的最少操作次数。如果条件已经满足，则输出 0。
